Overview

North Charleston is a city in SC with a population of 115,000. Charleston’s industrial hub with the Charleston International Airport and Riverfront Park. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.3.
